question: What sequence of worship must the practitioner follow regarding the limbs and the group of eight?
premises: The practitioner first worships the limbs.
After worshipping the limbs, the practitioner should worship the group of eight.
inference: Worship of the group of eight must be preceded by worship of the mantra limbs.
uncertainties: The repetition of aṅgāni may be emphatic or textual; taken as emphasis on limb worship.
plain_english: One who, having first worshipped the limbs, should then worship the group of eight.
